context: Coastal Fukuoka, late afternoon. Eight-year-old Hina is visiting grandpa Goro and has asked him to tell her a story about when he was young.
purpose: oral history — grandfather telling, granddaughter listening

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、お話して。一番面白いの。
lines.en: Grandpa, tell me a story. The most interesting one.
lines.style: Sits down very close. The demand is delivered as if she's pre-paid for it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 一番、なあ。…むかし、おじいちゃんが、お前くらいの時にな。
lines.en: The most interesting, eh. …Long ago, when grandpa was about your age.
lines.style: Slow, gravelly. Each clause arrives separately. Kyushu warmth. Looks somewhere far away during the second sentence.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: One syllable, all attention. She has folded herself smaller.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 一人で、海まで歩いてったんよ。誰にも言わんで。
lines.en: I walked all the way to the sea by myself. Didn't tell anyone.
lines.style: A small forbidden gleam in the voice. The 「言わんで」 is Kyushu confessional charm.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure eight-year-old astonishment. The 「本当に？」 is half a question, half a request to repeat it.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 本当に、一人でな。お母さんに、後で本当に怒られた。
lines.en: Really, all alone. Got told off by my mother good and proper afterward.
lines.style: Half-laugh inside the gravel. The memory is amused.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A small worried lift. She's thinking about it as if it could happen to her.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 怖かったよ。最初な。でも、海、見たら、なんも怖くなくなった。
lines.en: I was. At first. But once I saw the sea — none of it felt scary anymore.
lines.style: Slowest line yet. The 「見たら」 is the centre of the story. Eyes still somewhere far away.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: すごい。…ひなも、いつか一緒に見たい。
lines.en: Wow. …I want to see it together someday too.
lines.style: Small, warm. The 「一緒に」 is the gift she's giving back to him.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: よし。じゃあ、時間ある時、二人で行こう。
lines.en: Alright. When there's time, we'll go — the two of us.
lines.style: Quiet promise. Both clauses spoken at the same patient pace as the rest of the story. JP and EN: same settled warmth.
